items.question: What accompaniment is required for mantra recitation during an attraction rite?
premises: Mantra recitation is prescribed for specific ritual applications.
An attraction rite constitutes a distinct ritual application.
Intoxicated-elephant-tusk jewels are specified as the accompaniment.
items.inference: In an attraction rite, one should recite the mantra with intoxicated-elephant-tusk jewels.
items.plain_english: One should recite the mantra with jewels from the tusks of intoxicated elephants in an attraction rite.
